sections.title: Headline
sections.content: No concrete, attributable major-AI-organization event for October 13, 2026 was supported by the supplied search results. Older announcements and undated pages were excluded.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The fixed search set returned stale or undated material for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, and xAI. A generic roundup page claimed to cover October 13, but its search snippet did not identify any specific announcement and carried conflicting date information; it was not counted as an event. Treat this as no event surfaced in the searched material, not proof that none occurred.
